'''Jenny Yokobori''' is an American actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|Horizons}}. She is currently affiliated with Atlas Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Yokobori is an American voice actor born on February 11, 1997. Yokobori first became a voice actress in 2014 and went on to voice numerous characters. Yokobori joined the franchise during {{aniseries|JN}}, voicing [[Goh]]'s friend and [[Project Mew]] [[rival]] [[Horace]].
